description: This file defines the Exception class for the SuiteCRM application, extending PHP's built-in Exception class. It includes methods for constructing exceptions with custom messages and codes, providing exception details, and determining log levels. It also includes licensing and project information in comments.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\Exception\Exception
classes.description: Custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception, with additional methods for detailed error info and log level.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a message, code, and previous exception, prefixing the message with '[SuiteCRM]'.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns a string indicating that SuiteCRM encountered an unhandled exception.

methods.name: getLogLevel
methods.description: Returns the log level for this exception, specifically LogLevel::CRITICAL.
